description: See a Snapchat ad before it spends: a Snap-hosted preview page of the creative (no login, live for 90 days), its type and its review status. snapcode:true adds a Snapcode image to scan with the Snapchat app (its expiry is printed). Pass creativeId, or adId to preview the creative that ad uses. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

adId.description: ad id whose creative should be previewed

creativeId.description: creative id to preview; or pass adId

snapcode.description: true adds a Snapcode image to scan with the Snapchat app

name: preview_snapchat_ads_creative
title: Preview a Snapchat ad
